prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a vast white salt flat reflecting the sky with a smooth flat floor and a standard-height wooden doorway frame standing at her side, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Jamaican woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, soft pastel-peach hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on gold chain (a silver miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (an iron ship's anchor, a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver bracelets. Extremely long almond nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral medallion border filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme red platform stiletto Mary Janes, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Nigerian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a handsome male model face with high cheekbones, a straight nose, a firm jaw and straight dark brows, clean-shaven, sparkling glitter dusted under the eyes with rose-gold eyeshadow, deep rich dark-brown skin with a smooth satin glow, a soft amused smile, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a lead miniature anvil, a bronze square-sided cowbell, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a silver barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (an iron barrel-shaped weight, a silver small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three gold hair ornaments. Extremely long round nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide; a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle, the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape; a full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform stiletto corset-lace boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
